headline: Presco Reports 8.5% Profit Growth to ₦151.5 Billion in First Nine Months
summary: Nigeria's edible oil business Presco Plc announced an 8.5% year-on-year increase in Profit Before Tax to ₦151.5 billion for the first nine months of 2026.
why: Earnings reports provide key fundamental data for institutional investors evaluating the profitability and operational resilience of major agricultural and consumer goods producers in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Presco Plc
impacts.why: The company reported its own financial results showing profit growth.
